title: 阿富汗选举访谈（下）

sentences.en: Now listen to part two of the interview.
sentences.zh: 现在请听访谈的第二部分。
sentences.asr_text: Now listen to part two of the interview.
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: Questions six to ten are based on part two of the interview.
sentences.zh: 第6至10题根据访谈的第二部分提问。
sentences.asr_text: Questions six to ten are based on part two of the interview.
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: Let me turn it on to the man who may end up the winner, Mr. Ashraf Ghani.
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 让我们转向那位可能最终胜出的候选人，阿什拉夫·加尼先生。

sentences.en: What pressure, if any, are you trying to bring on him to ensure that whatever happens he tried to include Abdullah Abdullah, or Abdullah Abdullah’s people in any future government?
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 你们是否正在对他施加压力，以确保无论结果如何，他都会设法让阿卜杜拉·阿卜杜拉本人或其阵营的人进入未来的政府？如果有，具体是什么压力呢？

sentences.en: We’re not making any assumptions about who might be the winner or who might be the loser, and we think it’s premature for anybody to be doing so.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 我们没有预先认定谁会赢、谁会输，而且认为任何人现在就下判断都为时过早。

sentences.en: We’ve made clear to both candidates that two things need to happen.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 我们已经向两位候选人明确表示，有两件事必须做到。

sentences.en: First of all, there needs to be a robust and transparent process for determining the winner; and there’s still a good deal of work to be done there.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 首先，需要一个强有力而透明的程序来确定获胜者，而在这方面还有大量工作要做。

sentences.en: And secondly, we believe that both candidates need to begin discussing the formation of a government that would have the support of all important components and elements within the country, a government of national unity that would ensure that all of the significant sectors of Afghan society feel included.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 其次，我们认为，两位候选人都需要开始讨论组建政府的问题；这个政府应获得国内所有重要组成力量的支持，也就是一个民族团结政府，确保阿富汗社会所有重要群体都感到自己被接纳。

w.m: n.社会群体；社会中的部分

sentences.en: You’re saying it’s all a bit hasty to say whether one side or the other has won or lost.
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 也就是说，现在就认定哪一方赢了或输了，还有些操之过急。

sentences.en: It is difficult, is it not, to see this result being overturned?
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 不过，这个结果恐怕很难被推翻，不是吗？

sentences.en: This is a flat margin of victory at the moment—56 percent to 44 percent.
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 目前双方的得票率是56%对44%。

sentences.en: It would be extraordinary to see the results overturned in the space of a couple of weeks.
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 要在短短几个星期内推翻这个结果，会非常不寻常。

sentences.en: I think both candidates have agreed that there was extensive fraud in the electoral process.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 我认为两位候选人都承认，选举过程中存在大规模舞弊。

sentences.en: Both candidates have agreed that the suspect ballots need to be audited.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 两位候选人也都同意，可疑选票需要接受审查。

sentences.en: They haven’t agreed on exactly how to go about that.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 但他们还没有就具体如何开展审查达成一致。

sentences.en: We believe it’s the responsibility of the electoral institutions to go ahead and conduct that kind of broad audit, whether or not the candidates have agreed on every precise element of the process, they will have to do it, and we believe until they’ve done so it’s premature to be coming to any judgments.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 我们认为，选举机构有责任推进并开展这种广泛审查；无论候选人是否就程序的每一个细节达成一致，选举机构都必须去做。在完成审查之前，我们认为作出任何判断都为时过早。

sentences.en: It is worrying though, isn’t it?
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 但这仍然令人担心，不是吗？

sentences.en: I suppose it was all too predictable that democracy is an imperfect thing in Afghanistan and that undoubtedly there has been fraud, we’ve heard all sorts of reports that project there has been a measure of fraud, and whoever was going to lose in this election was going to say it’s been by unfair means.
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 我想，在阿富汗，民主并不完善，而且毫无疑问存在舞弊，这都是完全可以预见的。我们也听到各种报道称，存在一定程度的舞弊；无论最后谁输掉这场选举，都会说自己遭到了不公平的对待。

sentences.en: I agree with you that Afghanistan is a relatively new democracy.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 我同意，阿富汗是一个民主制度相对较新的国家。

sentences.en: The countries at this stage of democratic development often have difficulties of this sort.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 处于这个民主发展阶段的国家，往往会遇到这类困难。

sentences.en: That there’s not a tradition of good losers in societies at this level of political development.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 政治发展处于这种水平的社会，还没有形成坦然接受败选的传统。

w.m: phr.能够坦然接受失败的人

sentences.en: And in that sense, the problem we face is not unparalleled.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，我们面临的问题并不是绝无仅有的。

sentences.en: There are other countries who have gone through similar difficulties.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 其他国家也经历过类似困难。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the fact is that millions of Afghans went out and voted in the expectation that their vote would count.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 不过，事实是，数百万阿富汗人走出去投票，是期待自己的选票能够真正起作用。

sentences.en: That numerous polls indicate that most Afghans are prepared to support either candidate as the victor.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 大量民意调查也表明，多数阿富汗人愿意支持两位候选人中的任何一位成为胜者。

sentences.en: That most Afghans have said that they could accept the person they didn’t vote for winning the election if that was the result.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 大多数阿富汗人表示，如果选举结果如此，他们可以接受自己没有投票支持的人获胜。

sentences.en: So, while the problems we face are not unparalleled, the Afghan voters expect something better.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然我们面临的问题并非绝无仅有，但阿富汗选民仍然期待更好的结果。

sentences.en: James, I am so grateful to you.
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: I hugely appreciate you answering it and answering all the other questions as well.
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你回答了这个问题，以及其他所有问题。

sentences.en: Pleasure.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: This is the end of part two of the interview.
sentences.zh: 访谈的第二部分到此结束。
sentences.asr_text: This is the end of part two of the interview.
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: Questions six to ten are based on what you have just heard.
sentences.zh: 第6至10题根据你刚才听到的内容提问。
sentences.asr_text: Questions six to ten are based on what you have just heard.
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: Question 6. What does the interviewee think both candidates need to do?
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 第6题：受访者认为，两位候选人都需要做些什么？

sentences.en: Question 7. What was the margin of victory at the time of the interview?
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 第7题：在本次访谈发生时，两位候选人的得票率相差多少？

sentences.en: Question 8. Who should be responsible for dealing with fraud in the election?
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 第8题：谁应该负责处理选举中的舞弊问题？

sentences.en: Question 9. What does the interviewee think of the problem in the Afghan election?
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 第9题：受访者如何看待阿富汗选举中的问题？

sentences.en: Question 10. What is the interview mainly about?
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 第10题：这次访谈主要讨论什么？

sentences.en: This is the end of part one, listening comprehension.
sentences.zh: 第一部分听力理解到此结束。
sentences.asr_text: This is the end of part one, listening comprehension.
sentences.speaker: announcer
